action.sql: SELECT a.actual, b.budget, ROUND(100.0 * a.actual / NULLIF(b.budget, 0), 1) AS pct_used FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.debit - g.credit), 0) AS actual FROM gl_lines g WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND CAST(g.account_id AS VARCHAR) = '6500' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') a, (SELECT SUM(bu.amount) AS budget FROM budgets bu WHERE bu.entity_id = 'CA01' AND CAST(bu.account_id AS VARCHAR) = '6500' AND bu.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') b
